What could go wrong is tomorrow morning. Three meetings sit on top of your flight: Sales and Recruiting at 9:15, Sales Scrum at 10:00, and the GEHC technical deep dive at 11:00. All three need conflict notices or named coverage tonight, not from the jet bridge. Two personal notes: Dawn Dearstone's birthday is today and she will be at your table at Gordon Ramsay Steak tomorrow at 7pm Vegas time; a text tonight costs thirty seconds. The SMU panel is behind you, but the pattern from today's chain holds for the retreat: everything you owe people needs to move before you board. Email brought seven actionable items, led by the LSYPO waiver that pairs with your 4pm Shelly Kaiser sync and the CorpLanta dress code flag for the retreat you are packing for right now. Success tonight looks like three sends (conflict notices), one text (Dawn), and one decision (Derek). Attack order: clear tomorrow's collisions, then pack.
